---
title: "Gene-set enrichment"
output: html_document
---

This analysis summarizes the Core Class and meta-program over-representation
tests and the pre-ranked injury-homeostasis axis enrichment. Pathway statistics
and adjusted P values are supplied as processed inputs because the underlying
gene-set collections retain their original provider licences. The script applies
the manuscript significance thresholds and regenerates the enrichment panels.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "08_enrichment.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/08_enrichment/enrichment_summary.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

Significant pathways and the figure are written to
`analysis/08_enrichment/`.
